title: Cross-intersecting families with covering number constraints
summary: Two families $\mathcal{F}$ and $\mathcal{G}$ are cross-intersecting if every set in $\mathcal{F}$ intersects every set in $\mathcal{G}$. The covering number $τ(\mathcal{F})$ of a family $\mathcal{F}$ is the minimum size of a set that intersects every member of $\mathcal{F}$. In 1992, Frankl and Tokushige determined the maximum of $|\mathcal{F}| + |\mathcal{G}|$ for cross-intersecting families $\mathcal{F} \subset \binom{[n]}{a}$ and $\mathcal{G} \subset \binom{[n]}{b}$ that are non-empty (covering number at least 1) and also characterized the extremal configurations.
